scripts.lint: uv run ruff format --check src tests scripts && uv run ruff check src tests scripts
scripts.test: uv run pytest -q -m "not browser" && npm run test:ui
scripts.check:diff: git diff --check HEAD && GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=pull_request PR_BASE_SHA=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD) PR_HEAD_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD) bash scripts/check_ci_diff.sh
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:ui && npm run build && npm run check:migrations && npm run check:diff && npm run test:all
scripts.dev:local: npm run build && uv run python src/local_runtime.py
